resources.string: This version was modified by carlito and is based on the upstream DiPlay project.
Could not open the project link

Navigation has its own channel. All other sound uses the media channel. Bluetooth output keeps car Bluetooth music and avoids duplicate music while it is playing. Calls and voice remain available. If Bluetooth playback cannot be detected, CarPlay continues playing. Applies after reconnecting.
Prepares a Wi-Fi Direct connection automatically. For the car hotspot, select Built-in car hotspot.
Keep the car Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and iPhone Wi-Fi on.
Show the next turn, distance and road name on a secondary display. Allow display-over-apps access when asked.
No secondary display is available. Turn on HUD projection in the head unit, then return to this page.
Install Vehicle Data Bridge to use steering wheel buttons for playback and Siri.
Choose an action and press its steering button. The result fills in automatically. Save to apply it and upload the configuration to cloud.
Choose the action you want to identify.
Button detected. Press the same button again for %1$s.
No complete button information received. Allow button access first; if identification still fails, send a report through Collect logs.
Button detected. Press and release it once more.
Enabling button access. Allow DiPlay to connect if an approval prompt appears.
Allow DiPlay in the head unit’s approval prompt and try again.
Automatic button access is unavailable. Try identification; if there is still no response, send a report through Collect logs.
Button access was not granted. Check approval and try again.
This button has moved from %1$s to %2$s. Save to apply it.
Original controls restored. Save again to enable this configuration.
%1$s is filled in. Save to apply it.
Could not export. Choose another location and try again.
Identify at least one button first.
Saved. The identified buttons are now active.
Could not save the configuration. Try again.
Saved on this head unit. Cloud has received the configuration.
Saved on this head unit. Waiting for cloud upload; it will retry when internet is available.
Saved on this head unit. Cloud upload failed; save again to retry.
Saving uploads the vehicle model, head unit information and button mappings to cloud.

DiPlay runs its own log reader. Automatic permission setup requires network ADB on the head unit. An approved ADB connection can also run: adb shell pm grant %1$s android.permission.READ_LOGS. The head unit must emit key logs and allow apps to receive its key broadcasts.
Enter stable button log fragments. Separate fragments with &&; all must appear for one trigger. Omit changing timestamps and process identifiers.
Enter a log source and 1 to 4 fragments of up to 160 characters each.
Choose a square image for CarPlay’s button that returns to the car home screen. The new icon is used on the next connection.
Describe the problem, when it happened, and what you expected
Keep the problem description under 2,000 characters.
Uploads only when you tap the button. The problem description and redacted diagnostic report are sent together.
The cloud received your problem description and diagnostic report.
Check the head unit’s internet connection and try again.
This report is larger than 1 MiB. Save it locally and share it manually.
Could not open sharing. Try again or share the saved report from your file manager.
The iPhone connected, but CarPlay did not finish starting
Select a device or enter its number, then play a test sound to find the speaker you want.
